// expressions / errors / propagation
const user = decode(raw)?;
//           ^^^^^^ entity.name.function.call.ds
//                      ^ keyword.operator.postfix.ds

JSON.stringify(value)? satisfies string;
//                   ^ keyword.operator.postfix.ds
//                     ^^^^^^^^^ keyword.operator.type.binary.ds

const value = maybe ?? fallback;
//                  ^^ keyword.operator.boolean.ds

// expressions / errors / try catch finally
try {
// <- keyword.control.exception.ds
    read()?
} catch (error: unknown) {
    recover(error)
} finally {
    cleanup();
}

// expressions / errors / catch match
try {
// <- keyword.control.exception.ds
    read()?
} catch match (failure) {
    Missing(path) => create(path),
    IOError(error) => throw error
}
